Its coordinate bounds are c_(0,1)<x_0<=c_(0,2), c_(1,0)<x_1<=c_(1,1), matching its label and cut positions. All other labels agree with their surrounding cuts.

This is exactly the Statement iterated-sum identity for the six cells, established generally in proof step 5.1. The diagram introduces no map, orientation, commutativity or graph-edge assertion. The rigorous proof remains independent of the illustration.
